notes: A third tab: Positions. Not a deck — a map. 156 positions and 426 transitions harvested from sexinfo101.com's own taxonomy, so every way out is a move their page actually names rather than one this app invented. You say where you are; it shows you three ways out of it, one per family, so the doors are three different shapes instead of three variations of the one you are in. Tap a position to open their illustrated guide. Nothing is drawn, spent, tiered or scored, and nothing is counted — the moment it counts it becomes a checklist. Each position carries a LOAD: how much it asks of the person underneath. New Tonight switch to go with it — Gentle tonight caps the map at easy, which is the one toggle the app was missing. Limits and Tonight both filter it, and neither can ever add back what a hard no took away.
